style: Straightforward flat vector illustration in blue-black (#0f1419), coral (#ff6f59) and white, clean industrial shapes, no text.

subjects.mecanique-generale: An open car engine bay seen from above with a plain smooth engine cover (no emblem, no badge); a hand-held diagnostic scanner lies on the fender, plugged in by its cable, a combination wrench beside it. No hands, no people.

hero: An industrial-park repair garage interior: a car on a lift, a coral tool chest, a wall of wrenches, a roll-up door closed, bright overhead lights. All cars are generic invented designs: no recognizable real models, no brand grilles, no badges or emblems. Flat vector, DARK blue-black overall, coral highlights, white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no numbers.
